result.keywords: This article examines a fictional decision-support framework for coordinating cold-chain cargo, tide-aware routing, and seasonal harvest forecasting across small island port networks. The proposed model combines sensor telemetry, stochastic demand smoothing, and low-bandwidth reporting to optimize dispatch timing for mixed ferry and drone delivery fleets. Simulation results are presented for perishable fruit, shellfish, and medical supplies under variable weather and dock availability conditions.
result.title: Lantern Metrics for Orchard Logistics in Coastal Archipelagos.
